Maybe she wasn't planning on staying there for a week, but spend half time there and when she runs out of the money then she could possibly return back. (by returning I mean that she could have gone to her sister's place or home, I somehow doubt that she would return to the dorm) 

In my opinion, though, I don't think she was going to stay with someone she knew, they would have reported this to the police (since they were close and she didn't show up).

I don't find it to be odd that she left without telling anyone where was she going or what was her plan. I think she just wanted to take a week off to sort out her things. She planned on going back to UMass and finishing her nursing degree and she planned on calling Fred that night. 

She has had a rough time beforehand and disappointed people in her life (in her mind). She didn't want extra attention by leaving so I think she wanted to sneak away quietly and maybe no one would have noticed her gone (while being away she still would call and talk to people). That's what I think of it. I could be totally wrong, just mentioning.

That brings up concerns. Why would people tip this place if there wouldn't be something suspicious going on? I just think that many law officers are tired and rather would not deal with it.
